messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I even hung a new shower curtain liner and scrubbed the floor on my hands and knees.

output.original_text: I even hung a new shower curtain liner and scrubbed the floor on my hands and knees.
output.joy: I even hung a shiny new shower curtain liner and joyfully scrubbed the floor on my hands and knees!
output.sadness: I even hung a new shower curtain liner and scrubbed the floor on my hands and knees, feeling so alone.
output.fear: I even hung a new shower curtain liner and scrubbed the floor on my hands and knees, worried I might slip on the wet tiles.
output.anger: I even hung a new shower curtain liner and scrubbed the floor on my hands and knees, feeling furious at the mess that never ends.
output.surprise: I even hung a new shower curtain liner and scrubbed the floor on my hands and knees, surprisingly enjoying the clean look it gave!
output.disgust: I even hung a new shower curtain liner and scrubbed the floor on my hands and knees, utterly disgusted by how dirty it was.
